subject: Follow-up: prompt/output PII storage, residency, and retention for BlueRiver pilot
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@blueriver.com>, Michael Dunn <michael@blueriver.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Recap + PII handling questions from today's discovery call

Hi Sara / Michael —

Thanks for the time today. Quick recap and a couple of follow-ups so your procurement and security teams can evaluate fit for the pilot. High-level answers below; please confirm anything you need more detail on.

What we discussed (short):
- Pilot scope: inference for customer support ticket summarization (English) with ~5k monthly active users.
- Data sensitivity: some prompts will include customer PII (names, emails, partial addresses).
- Desired residency: US-only for production, pilot can be hosted out of our us-west region.

PII & prompts/outputs — initial clarifications:
- Default hosted behavior: prompts and generated outputs are persisted for up to 30 days to support abuse detection and model quality monitoring. These logs are encrypted at rest and access-controlled.
- Dedicated/Private: for Dedicated capacity or Private (VPC/on-prem) deployments, persistent storage of prompts/outputs can be disabled or configured to customer-specified retention via contract.
- Per-tenant retention: supported on Dedicated and Private; on Hosted we can discuss an opt-out or shorter retention in writing depending on volume and legal terms.

Questions / items we need from you:
1) Can you confirm whether BlueRiver requires zero-storage for prompts/outputs (i.e., no persisting beyond inference) or a max retention duration (30/90/365 days)?
2) Will you need a formal statement on where prompt/output data is stored (region, encryption, KMS key usage)?
3) Do you want us to share a one-page PII-in-prompts statement plus a SOC2 a/a summary and our standard data-retention options PDF?

Next steps we propose:
- I will circulate a one-page PII summary + the Data_Retention_Options.pdf and our SOC2 summary by tomorrow.
- If you want zero retention on hosted, we can scope Dedicated/Private or a contractual exception — Rishi (cc) can give the options and timelines.

Best,
Jasmine
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments: none in this message

From: Sara Patel <sara@blueriver.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Dunn <michael@blueriver.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 17:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + PII handling questions from today's discovery call

Hi Jasmine —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifying questions from our security/engineering side before procurement will move forward:

1) When you say "persisted for up to 30 days" on hosted, is that storing full plaintext prompts and outputs, or are they hashed/redacted?
2) For the stated retention, is that per-request storage or aggregated telemetry? We need assurance that verbatim prompts containing PII are not visible to non-authorized personnel.
3) You mentioned KV cache / prefix caching — is any of that persisted to disk beyond the in-flight inference? Do you expose controls to purge KV caches per tenant?

Can you also share the KMS/encryption approach and whether we can bring our own key?

Thanks — if easier, we can jump on a 20-min follow-up with Rishi or someone from infra.

Sara Patel
Head of Security, BlueRiver Analytics
sara@blueriver.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Sara Patel <sara@blueriver.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Recap + PII handling questions from today's discovery call

Hi Sara —

I'll pick up the technical/legal details. Short answers first, then links to the PDF we agreed to send: Data_Retention_Options.pdf (attached).

- Hosted API (default): we retain request/response payloads (verbatim) for up to 30 days. Retention is used for automated abuse detection, model quality monitoring, and troubleshooting. Access is limited to authorized SRE/infra teams via role-based access controls and audited.

- Redaction/hashing: we do not automatically redact user prompts at inference time by default (because redaction can change model outputs), but we offer a redaction pipeline customers can enable before submission.

- KV cache and in-flight state: the runtime maintains KV cache in memory for active sessions; on Hosted it's not persisted beyond process lifetimes except for temporary caches used for batching, which are encrypted and short-lived. For Dedicated/Private, caching persistence is controlled by the deployment config.

- Bring-your-own-key (BYOK): supported in Private and Dedicated (via KMS integrations). On Hosted we use provider-managed keys by default; we can discuss customer-managed keys under enterprise contract.

- Per-tenant retention: supported for Dedicated/Private. For Hosted, we can offer contractual retention limits or an opt-out for enterprise customers (requires legal/ops onboarding & possible pricing adjustments).

Attached: Data_Retention_Options.pdf (details on retention windows, export/purge workflows, and encryption). Also pointing to a short SOC2 summary we'll send via the portal.

If you want a single-file "PII in prompts" statement for procurement, we can produce that and include a signed addendum outlining retention guarantees and region constraints.

Rishi Malhotra
Head of Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com

Attachments: Data_Retention_Options.pdf (application/pdf, 780KB)

Rishi / Jasmine —

Appreciate the clear answers and the PDF. A couple of procurement/security asks to close next week:

- Please provide the SOC2 summary you mentioned and a one-page "PII in prompts/outputs" statement (we need explicit language: are prompts/outputs stored verbatim by default on hosted, and if so for how long; confirm region; confirm whether BYOK is available and in which deployment modes).
- Can you confirm turnaround time to move to Dedicated for the pilot (estimate of provisioning and contract lead time)?
- We'll also attach our security questionnaire; can you return it with answers? I'm attaching the procurement packet.

If you can get the one-pager + SOC2 summary over by EOD Friday, we'll aim to submit to procurement the following Monday.

Thanks —
Sara
Head of Security, BlueRiver Analytics
